1.web: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
1.asv: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

2.web: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
2.asv: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; Forso he giveth unto his beloved sleep.

3.web: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
3.asv: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; Andthe fruit of the womb ishisreward.

4.web: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
4.asv: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.

5.web: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
5.asv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
